paper_id: SLAM_ Towards Efficient Multilingual Reasoning via Selective Language Alignment
title: SLAM: Towards Efficient Multilingual Reasoning via Selective Language Alignment
motivation: 全参数两阶段训练计算资源消耗大且导致灾难性遗忘
problem_framing: 如何精准识别并微调仅负责多语言理解的底层FFN层
key_insight: 语言特定表示仅在底层层学习，高层转化为通用表示
evaluation_criteria: 准确率、预测一致性比率PCR、训练效率
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 语言间数据不平衡导致不同语言对齐程度不等，性能权衡不可避免
evidence_for_taste: representation learning of languages is merely conducted in lower-level layers
languages is significantly influenced by a small subset of language-specific neurons
feed-forward layers store most of the multilingual knowledge
directly fine-tuning the language-specific layers will inevitably impair the model's inherent reasoning abilities
thinking_moves: 从神经元激活模式反推语言处理层次结构
将两阶段训练合并为单阶段以解决灾难性遗忘
通过MSD量化层的多语言参与度来精准选层
假设FFN存储多语言知识则只微调FFN即可
